title: Macular degeneration and diabetic retinopathy
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's eye condition.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for macular degeneration.

HPI
Pt is a 75-year-old female presenting for scheduled treatment of right eye macular degeneration. Pt reports stable vision but reports some blurring of central vision. Ophthalmology notes exudative changes in the right eye. Exam confirms active choroidal neovascularization.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg daily
Atorvastatin 20mg daily

Exam
Visual Acuity: 20/60 OD. Pupils equal, round, and reactive to light. Extraocular movements intact. Fundus exam shows exudative wet age-related macular degeneration of the right eye. Active CNV noted on imaging.

Assessment
1. Exudative age-related macular degeneration, right eye.
2. Active choroidal neovascularization.

Plan
Administered anti-VEGF injection to the right eye today. Pt tolerated procedure well without complications. F/u in 4-8 weeks for repeat imaging and vision check.

Electronically signed,
E. Castillo, DO
05/14/2026
explanations: Exudative (wet) AMD, right eye, with active choroidal neovascularization: H35.3211 (HCC 300).

distractors.why: Wet (exudative) AMD is documented; dry AMD has no HCC.
The neovascularization is documented as active.
